book.name: Lansoa Qorontoos
book.title: Kiristoos Yisa Tarjamonnante Kinin Yittsaa Bhawloos Qorontoos Eenana Kinin Thaapoono Lansono Warqanno

content: Ta keeda isa woylaminka “Yeam bucchana pir yedar nivattine” hamayse i bhocchade.
Harrna hambhidianna, inta yeam bucchidi i hanna, ta keeda inin bucchaana yekala ab, iam wozisea hayne?
Birayse yena inin thaapoonoar yekal inin nivenka, iam wozisa zaskayna eena iam kenin bucchoamadettsine. Harrna hambhidianna, isa wozano ye wulsaar woza koda maate inin hamonnane.
Gebhi gaalebee, woylamka qaabobee, thoothi ermitbeka yena inin thaapoono kattsi yeam inin nashenam yenin dhesoadettsi hamaysene; yeam bucchana hamaysetehe.
Seesaa Eana Ko Shidhe Haminta Zaskoono
Eedi hay ki hannaar, eediam bucchidi ki hanna, kinin bucchaa ibisheamtehe; yerinam shawkana dayma, ye wulam likka bucchidine.
Agaadettsea eana yesa thoothin eenin pirdoono dhabino kina yeeka ko yeeke.
Ogonante agaadettsea eana kattsi kinin burqadhoamadettsi “Ko shidhe” hamintabee kiam wocchisintabe yeam koda zaske.
“Ta keeda kiam yenin nashenam may kina dhehee” hamayse ida yeam miske.
Kosa birayse inin yena thaapoono taysate yeam shedayse yer wulka ee hamayna yenin dohonam dhesanane.
Yedi eedi haynaar “Ko shidhe” ye hamidianna, intaar pir kina “Ko shidhe” ida hame. “Ko shidhe” inin hamea daa ko hanna, inta yena hamayse Kiristoos birante kina i garade.
Ogoam inin hayaynoar Seethaansa maltamonam wonin dhesenna, Seethaan woam taysayse kanta kinin haapoamadettsi isa hamintane.
Kiristoossa dhacchintan upsinam giyana Thirovadda katamante i yivaysaka, Imbaa wontea Yesus Barjosa waadimanna keri ina bulidine.
Ko dahaannaar isa imbanaasa Tiitoam inin haapaamonna, isa woylammo ukunsadehe. Ogonante Thirovadda gidir dohoono Barjodar woylamin qajaynaam nagaysayse Moqodoonia peendar i yivade.
Ko dahaannaar rooro wul Kiristoossa bashintanka woam gobshayse entseabee payya gaamen shittoysa dohoono Kiristoos goynsa timmirinam raq wulir wonin yeskisoadettsi woam hayea Barjona gobshi ko dee.
Harrna hambhidianna, dhaqayna eenabee kayayna eenabesa shaarinte wodi Kiristoos Barjona kinin imen gaamen qunyandettsine.
Kayayna eenana ko hanna, deesen dembhin shittondettsine; dhaqayna eenana ko hanna, sadaka daadhen imen gaamen shittondettsine. Ta waadiman ogoam hayota yeekea hayne?
Wodi Barjosa upsinam gaban koymon bhulsayna thoothina eenadettsitehe; Barjokalanka nittsadhaana Kiristooska maatayse Barjo birante gon woda giye.
